newsitem.title: JAPAN: Strong earthquake hits southwestern Japan.
newsitem.headline: Strong earthquake hits southwestern Japan.

text.p: A strong earthquake shook wide areas of southwestern Japan on Wednesday, NHK public television said.
The quake registered five on the Japanese scale of seven in western Japan's Shimane prefecture, NHK said. There were no immediate reports of damage or casualties.
The Meteorological Agency later reported that the earthquake measured 5.9 on the Richter scale.
An earthquake of that magnitude could cause heavy damage to buildings and other facilities.
The epicentre of the tremor was about 20 km (12.5 miles) underground near Yamaguchi prefecture, which is 782 km (489 miles) southwest of Tokyo, it said.
There was no possibility of the earthquake triggering tidal waves, it added.
